zh.text: 宇宙配置页新增「伊甸币商城」编辑器与上架向导。编辑器把服务端里「一件游戏内商品 = 货架记录 + 收银台记录」这对数据合成一行来改，改价时两边一起写（货架写 offerPricings 的 PLEX 价、收银台写 plexPriceInCents 的分值），不会出现「游戏里显示一个价、实际扣另一个价」；列表把游戏内可见的排在前面并标出来，只能走收银台的条目单独筛，每行可删除（二次确认，四处记录一起删）。上架向导可从 26896 条物品表里搜索选货，支持五种发货方式（单件物品 / 组合包 / Omega 时长 / 多角色训练槽 / 发放 PLEX），一次写全货架、商品目录、offer 内嵌 products 与收银台四处，商品 ID 与 slug 自动取最大值并避让重名。商品名、描述、标签只收可打印 ASCII —— 客户端按 Latin-1 解这些字段，中文会显示成乱码。图片必填：物品自带客户端图标时自动填，没有图标的（矿石、舰船在客户端里本就没有）必须从「现有商品用过、已证明能显示」的图片里挑，客户端的占位图路径会被认出来并提示换掉。所选物品会先在服务端 52590 条物品库里核一遍，不在库里的直接拦住，避免上架后买了拿不到货。保存前要求先停服务端 —— 服务端自己的 owner 租约闸门会拒绝冲突写入。此前只能改服务端自带的 tools/NewEdenStoreEditor：桌面版依赖 Python 3，Web 版没有启动脚本、不绑 host 且没有任何鉴权。
补给线弹幕清掉演示名单，并改成严格均匀错峰的无缝循环，不再出现重新进场停顿。
价格史只取最近 30 天：此前没有窗口上限，随着天数累积点会越挤越糊、横轴日期也会退化成一堆重复月份。
物品市场首页不再被右侧「最近成交」一路撑长：整页改成占满窗口高度，三列各自在框内滚动，成交列表不再把页面顶到三四千像素。
物品市场的「价格史」换成对齐游戏内市场图表的样式：上下影线 + 日平均价散点 + 5 天 / 20 天均线 + 下方成交量柱，价格刻度在左、成交量刻度在右，带图例与鼠标读数。右栏放不下这些元素，改从「查看完整图表」打开大图。

en.text: Universe config gained a PLEX store editor and a listing wizard. The editor presents "one in-game product = shelf record + checkout record" as a single row: editing a price writes both sides (the PLEX price into the shelf's offerPricings, the cents value into the checkout's plexPriceInCents), so the store never shows one price and charges another. Rows visible in game are listed first and labelled, checkout-only entries can be filtered, and every row can be deleted (with a confirmation that removes all four records together). The listing wizard searches the 26,896-entry item table and supports five grant types (single item / bundle / Omega time / multiple character training slot / grant PLEX), writing all four places at once: the shelf offer, the product catalog, the offer's embedded products and the checkout record, with IDs and slugs derived from the current maximum and de-duplicated. Item name, description and tags accept printable ASCII only, because the client decodes those fields as Latin-1 and Chinese shows up as mojibake. An image is required: it is filled in automatically when the item has a client icon, and items without one (ores and ships have none in the client) must pick from images already proven to render, with the client's placeholder path detected and rejected. Every picked item is validated against the server's 52,590-entry item database first, so nothing can be listed that would deliver nothing when bought. The server must be stopped before saving, because its own owner-lease gate refuses conflicting writes. Previously the only option was the server's bundled tools/NewEdenStoreEditor: the desktop version needs Python 3, and the web version has no launcher script, does not bind a host and has no authentication at all.
The supply-line danmaku no longer shows the demo list and now loops seamlessly with strictly even staggering, so entries no longer pause on re-entry.
Price history is limited to the last 30 days. There was no window cap before, so as days accumulated the points grew denser and the date axis degenerated into a run of repeated months.

The item market page is no longer stretched by the recent-trades column on the right: the page now fills the window height and each of the three columns scrolls inside its own box, so a long trade list no longer pushes the page to three or four thousand pixels.

The item market's price history now matches the in-game market chart: high/low wicks, daily average dots, 5-day and 20-day moving averages and a volume histogram below, with the price axis on the left and volume on the right, plus a legend and hover readout. The right column cannot fit all of that, so it now opens as a larger view from "View full chart".
